selection: first model in each independent task ranking; no silent lower-ranked fallback

scope_notes.text_chat: English structured-task ranking is the current text proxy; not a broad chat or non-English certification.
scope_notes.image_recognition: Broader actual-service public-image cohort; cohort-specific object/OCR readiness, not general accuracy. Historical screening is explicit-only and not comparable.
scope_notes.image_moderation: Broader nine-category human-review assistance ranking by macro F2; invalid/abstained positives count as missed detection. Sparse positives and no standalone safety certification.
scope_notes.text_chat_hu: Experimental Hungarian short text/JSON: initial quality gate not met; human review required, no unattended factual decisions. Assistant-reviewed synthetic cases are not a native-speaker or fluency certification. No tools or Hungarian OCR approval.
